name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-12-18, at wavelengths from 1.24 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
